name: inositol polyphosphate phosphatase like 1

function.text: INPPL1 encodes phosphatidylinositol 3,4,5-trisphosphate 5-phosphatase 2. Annotated molecular activities include inositol-polyphosphate 5-phosphatase activity and phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate 5-phosphatase activity. It participates in endocytosis and cell adhesion.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to opsismodysplasia (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Endometrial Carcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
